title: A True & Faithful Relation of What Passed Between Dr John Dee and Some Spirits
author: John Dee
description: Meric Casaubon’s edition of John Dee’s records of conversations with spirits, documenting Dee and Edward Kelley’s early modern practices and claims.
editionNote: 1659 edition. London. Edition credit: ed. Meric Casaubon (1599–1671).
rights: Public-domain historical edition. Source credit and notices are retained.
